correctness.rationale: Every proper 2D subalgebra is a Borel because its derived generator is nilpotent in odd characteristic. Projective eigenline incidence gives exact graph adjacency. The unsigned complete-graph incidence matrix gives the displayed middle-graph characteristic polynomial, and a direct clique blowup decomposition gives each eigenspace. Matrix-tree then supplies the spanning-tree formula; graph coloring and matching give alpha and chi. Exact all-pair field checks for q=3,5 and coefficientwise integer charpolys agree; no extrapolation is used as proof.

value.rationale: Solvable graphs of Lie algebras are a recently introduced structural tool. Degrees and disconnectedness do not determine graph topology or spectrum. This exact description gives every edge, all component types, an all-q factorization of the Laplacian and a nontrivial exact spanning-tree count, with additional chromatic and independence invariants.
